sources.countingRule: OSB relationship types are the distinct Neo4j type strings across every model class, with a type or target written as a NAME resolved the way a Python class body resolves it (an assignment in the same class body, else a module-level one); a type declared on several classes counts once (250); a declaration commented out in the source is not counted. Classes are every class statement in the model files except _utils.py (273).
sources.builder: scripts/build-osb-csl-structure-map.mjs --check refuses the map when it and the inventories disagree; --stamp writes mapHash; --out copies it to OpenStudyBuilder

correspondenceVocabulary.exact: the two sides name the same kind of object
correspondenceVocabulary.broader: the CSL type covers more than the OSB structure
correspondenceVocabulary.narrower: the CSL type is one facet of the OSB structure, or the OSB structure is one facet of the CSL type
correspondenceVocabulary.property: the OSB structure is a property (or a property value) of a CSL object, not an object
correspondenceVocabulary.edge: the OSB structure is a relationship model; CSL states it as a link type or link properties
correspondenceVocabulary.versioning: OSB Root/Value/version machinery; CSL states it as entity_revision rows
correspondenceVocabulary.audit: OSB audit trail; CSL states it as entity_revision rows and the audit_event chain
correspondenceVocabulary.abstract: an OSB base class with no instances of its own
correspondenceVocabulary.platform: OSB platform or library infrastructure with no clinical meaning
correspondenceVocabulary.none: no counterpart; the reason is stated

relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.link: a CSL link type (the target names it; direction may be inverse)
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.property: a property of a CSL object (the target names type.property)
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.terminology: a terminology_binding row on the CSL object, or a terminology_code_system row
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.selection: a study selection of a library object; the selection and the object are one CSL entity
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.scope: study containment; the CSL entity carries study_id
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.platform: library, catalogue, configuration or user infrastructure
relationshipCorrespondenceVocabulary.none: no counterpart; the reason is stated
